description:
Record the weight and repetitions for each set.
View previous sessions, daily history, and exercise progress.
Edit exercises and sets, and add daily notes.

Records stay on each device.
No account or ads.
No data collection or tracking.
No cloud sync.

Available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro.
Apple Watch sends records to its paired iPhone.

Export and import backups, or export sets as CSV.
